answer: I would stop farms with keystroke dynamics profile per identity, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One knoll of signal, one thread of cost, one ivory of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
